candidates.angle: विष्णो, the name that recalls cosmic preservation, yet here brings dread
दृष्ट्वा, having seen, the act that breaks his inner being
न विन्दामि, I do not find, the loss of steadiness and peace
candidates.evidence: धृतिं न विन्दामि शमं च (I do not find steadiness and peace)

angle_en: Vishnu, the cosmic preserver, now the source of dread
angle_hi: विष्णु: ब्रह्मांड के रक्षक, अब भय के कारण

en.intro: Arjuna asked to see the universe, but the sight has shaken his inner being. Listen for the word that names the power he thought would save him.
en.notice: Arjuna calls out to Vishnu, the preserver of the cosmos. Yet the sky-touching blaze he sees does not bring him comfort. Instead, it takes away his steadiness and peace.
en.next: He admits he cannot find peace, and then he asks for grace to steady himself again.
en.meaning: O Vishnu, seeing you touching the sky, blazing with many colors, with mouths spread wide and bright, vast eyes, my inner being is shaken. I cannot find steadiness or peace.

hi.intro: अर्जुन ने ब्रह्मांड देखना माँगा था, पर यह दृश्य उनके मन को हिला देता है। उस शब्द को सुनिए जो उस रक्षक का नाम है जिसे वे अपना रक्षक मानते थे।
hi.meaning: हे विष्णो, आपका रूप आकाश को छूता है, अनेक वर्णों से प्रदीप्त है, आपका मुख व्यात्तानन है और नेत्र विशाल व प्रदीप्त हैं।
hi.notice: अर्जुन उन्हें विष्णु कहते हैं, जो इस ब्रह्मांड के रक्षक हैं। यह आकाश को छूने वाला तेजस्वी रूप उन्हें शान्ति नहीं देता और उनका धैर्य और शान्ति छिन लेता है।
hi.next: वे स्वीकार करते हैं कि उन्हें कोई शान्ति नहीं मिल रही है, और फिर वे भगवान से कृपा माँगते हैं ताकि वे स्थिर हो सकें।

en.intro: Arjuna asked to see the universe, but the sight has shaken his inner being. Listen for the word that names the power he thought would save him.
en.body: O Vishnu, seeing you touching the sky, blazing with many colors, with mouths spread wide and bright, vast eyes, my inner being is shaken. I cannot find steadiness or peace. Arjuna calls out to Vishnu, the preserver of the cosmos. Yet the sky-touching blaze he sees does not bring him comfort. Instead, it takes away his steadiness and peace. He admits he cannot find peace, and then he asks for grace to steady himself again.

issues: meaning_changed: "हे विष्णो, आपके अनेक चमकीले वर्ण हैं, आप आकाश को छू रहे हैं, आपका मुख फैला हुआ है और नेत्र प्रदीप्त व विशाल हैं।" (The Hindi translation incorrectly states 'आपके अनेक चमकीले वर्ण हैं' (you have many bright colors) instead of describing 'blazing with many colors' as an attribute of the form. It also omits 'with mouths spread wide and bright' (व्यात्ताननं) from the description of the face.)

contrast_template: "फिर भी यह आकाश को छूने वाला तेजस्वी रूप उन्हें शान्ति नहीं देता, बल्कि उनका धैर्य और शान्ति छिन लेता है।" (The notice section uses the contrast template 'बल्कि' (rather than/but) to imply that the form actively strips away his peace, which introduces a slightly different meaning than the original Sanskrit 'न विन्दामि शमं च' (I do not find peace).)
